one: Computational imaging: from convolution/denoising to inverse problems, wave optics, and end-to-end optics-algorithm co-design.
pos: CS 448I (EE 367) is taught by Gordon Wetzstein and is a core course in computational photography/imaging. It combines classical image processing, convex optimization, and modern AI, covering denoising, deconvolution, single-pixel imaging, ToF, wave optics, and end-to-end joint optimization of optics and algorithms.
topics: **CNNs for imaging**: image restoration, learned priors
assess: Assignments plus a term project, emphasizing implementation. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Computational photography, imaging systems, AR/VR, and microscopy/medical imaging.
tips: Brush up on linear algebra and signals & systems first. Pair with EE 367.
note: Offered in Winter 2026–27; no stable course-site link found.
